feature: ADR-0183 owned X11 probe process, bounded pipe reads and target-bound metadata protocol

linux.real_process_fixtures: Owned temporary Python helpers only; no X11/device access

initial_failures: Initial compact Drop implementation had a match-arm semicolon; corrected before checks. Real fixture, focused and full checks passed.

windows.scope: Linux-only job/pipe/process ownership changes. Portable shared tests ran on Linux; Windows native checks remain pending after prior approval quota rejection, without retry/bypass.

limitations: Report is XI metadata only. Actual session/consumer capability binding, active lease, mixed bootstrap/host/worker and capture admission remain pending.
X11 SDK headers and trusted library/live-server query remain unverified as recorded in ADR-0182/0181. Successful owned fixtures do not prove them.
Kill request is not exit; callers retain same job until actual observed status/EOF. Drop is bounded best effort and not complete cleanup proof.
Trusted explicit helper must not fork or inherit non-CLOEXEC input descriptors; this API is not arbitrary PID/group control or executable authentication.
Wayland consumer, hardware, Windows pointer, GUI/packaging and Rust driver acceptance remain pending.
